by_rule.title: Banned synonym for an OTel semconv field
by_rule.hint: Rename the field to the semconv name given in the message.
by_rule.example: §2: 'status' is a banned synonym; use http.response.status_code

by_rule.title: Environment value is not a documented one
by_rule.hint: Set deployment.environment.name to development, staging, test or production.
by_rule.example: §3: environment 'dev' must be one of development, staging, test, production

by_rule.title: Event is a constant snake_case name
by_rule.hint: Use a fixed name like import_completed and move variable data into fields: log.info("import_completed", rows_imported=n).
by_rule.example: §4: event 'Loaded 3 models' must be a constant snake_case name

by_rule.title: Failure line does not say what failed
by_rule.hint: On warning/error and *_failed lines log exc_info=True (gives exception.type), or error.type, or http.response.status_code.
by_rule.example: §10: 'upstream_call_failed' is a failure line without exception.type, error.type or http.response.status_code

by_rule.title: Required resource fields on every line
by_rule.hint: Add service.name, service.version and deployment.environment.name in one shared processor/formatter, not at call sites.

by_rule.title: Line is not a JSON object
by_rule.hint: Route every logger (including third-party libraries) through the JSON formatter. If the input mixes in non-log output, capture only the service's output.
by_rule.example: §1: line is not a JSON object (plain text)

by_rule.title: Semconv name written with underscores
by_rule.hint: Use the dotted semconv key (http_route -> http.route). In structlog pass it as **{"http.route": value}.

by_rule.title: Secret or personal data in a log line
by_rule.hint: Don't log secrets, tokens, credentials, emails or card numbers. Log an id, a size or a redacted value instead, and redact in the shared processor.
by_rule.example: §8: 'password' holds a secret or credential; don't log it (log an id or a redacted value)

by_rule.title: trace_id/span_id not in W3C format
by_rule.hint: Take trace_id and span_id from the active OTel span: format(ctx.trace_id, "032x") and format(ctx.span_id, "016x"); omit both when no span is active.
by_rule.example: §7: trace_id must be 32 lowercase hex characters (W3C), not all zeros

by_rule.title: Unknown field
by_rule.hint: Use the OTel semconv name if one exists. If it is a real domain field, declare it in logwarden-fields.yaml.
by_rule.example: Attribute 'foo_bar' does not exist in the registry.
